# Pattu Kutty

> Pattu Kutty is a women's clothing brand based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India, specializing in custom-made silk sarees, bridal wear and women's clothing. We customize any clothing item to your exact requirement, with stitching completed in as fast as 1 hour, and we deliver across India.

## About

Pattu Kutty (legal name: Pattu Kutty Clothing) is a women-centric clothing brand and tailoring studio.
It is physically located in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India, and serves customers across all of India.

- Name: Pattu Kutty
- Address: 463, Bharathiyar Road, Pappanaicken Palayam, Coimbatore – 641037, Tamil Nadu, India
- Phone: +91 93455 20768
- Website: https://pattukuttyclothing.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/pattu.kutty
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:30 AM – 8:30 PM IST; Sunday 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM IST
- Service area: Coimbatore (in person) and all of India (delivery)

## Core services

- Clothing Customization — any women's clothing item stitched to the customer's exact requirement. Turnaround: as fast as 1 hour on selected designs, next day for most garments.
- Saree Stitching — silk sarees, fancy sarees and designer sarees with matching blouses, stitched to measurement. Turnaround: as fast as 1 hour for express stitching.
- Bridal Wear & Kalyana Pattu — kalyana pattu sarees, bridal blouses, bridal lehengas and wedding frocks, made to the bride's measurements. Bridal orders are usually scheduled over a few days, with express slots available.
- Pan-India delivery — finished garments shipped anywhere in India from the Coimbatore studio.

## What Pattu Kutty covers

Pattu Kutty covers the full range of women's clothing, not only sarees: silk sarees, bridal dresses
and kalyana pattu sarees, half sarees and pattu pavadai, lehengas, blouses, frocks and everyday wear.
